selected_script.angle: hotel room wall outlet chaos with multiple chunky power bricks clashing
selected_script.hook: Struggling to fit three bulky charger bricks into a single messy hotel wall socket.

script_record.pain_point: Standard wall outlets don't fit multiple bulky charging bricks simultaneously.
script_record.conflict_hook: Hand struggles to jam multiple conflicting chargers into a small outlet, creating a tangled mess.
script_record.product_solution: Replacing the mess with a single ANRMESUN travel charger handling 4 USB cables effortlessly.
script_record.cta: A simple upgrade for everyday use.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in a realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life inefficient behavior using close-up details to amplify the pain point—a hand struggling to fit three bulky charging bricks into a single messy wall socket. 3-6s: Quickly introduce the compact white ANRMESUN travel adapter with coral-orange accents as the direct solution, plugging it in and connecting three USB cables cleanly. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing a phone, tablet, and smart watch charging neatly on a desk. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment. Keep pacing fast, clear, and product-focused. Maintain exact product identity: white smooth PC shell, sloped front logo, two USB-A, two USB-C ports.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video in a realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene 2 showing a hand pushing the coral-orange side slider to deploy regional pins, plugging the white adapter into a different wall socket. 4-8s: Fast-cut scene 3 showing final comfort and improved usage—a power bank charging via the bottom USB-C while a 2-prong plug uses the top universal AC receptacle with its visible orange safety shutters. 8-10s: Short text overlay CTA: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.' This segment must feel like the continuation of the previous 10-second segment. Keep the same product identity (white shell, coral-orange sliders, 65 GaN W mark), visual style, pacing, and usage logic.
